in_marathi.name: Delip
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Light, Clear, Radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Delip हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit ‘dīp’ meaning a lamp, light or clarity. It signifies the light of knowledge, wisdom and understanding. In Hindu mythology, Delip is a name of Lord Krishna, symbolizing the illuminating power of divine love.
